text:
Eli: quick problem - sampling + aggressive redaction breaks incident replay. ops can't link sampled rows to the originating field.
Mina: agree. what's the minimal privacy-safe join key?
Eli: propose tenant-scoped HMAC per sensitive field ("field-id"). store field-id alongside redacted value. deterministic, no mapping stored.
Oscar: how do we debug then? replays usually need exact values.
Eli: two replay modes: surrogate replay (default) and audit unredact (enterprise). surrogate = deterministic fake generated from field-id + schema so replays are realistic but not real PII.
Priya: attachments and embeddings? we can't HMAC whole blobs.
Eli: use chunked fingerprints for attachments (compact list) and hashed-span ids for embeddings. join keys only, no content.
Mina: GDPR deletion? we need a deletion flow.
Eli: tag key-version on logs. deletion: rotate tenant key, scrub per retention/legal, mark residuals deleted. legal to sign off on edgecases.
Oscar: routing/quotas: devs often want live-debugging. add opt-in debug pool with header X-Debug-Mode: debug. strict per-tenant caps and separate billing.
Priya: console UX idea: show redacted value, small field-id badge, and a "Preview surrogate" action with watermark. preview opt-in per session.
Mina: unredact ops path? existing breakglass?
Eli: extend breakglass: CSR ticket + 2 approvers (legal+sec) + ephemeral KMS decrypt key with TTL and immutable audit log.
OpsBot: feature-flag created: "field_id_preview" on eng-platform.
Oscar: perf: HMAC per-field at ingest needs benchmark. prototype middleware first.
Priya: metrics to track: surrogate confusion tickets, collision alerts, debug-pool abuse, unredact request rate.
Eli: rollout plan: 1) telemetry-only emit ids (2w), 2) console canary (3w), 3) debug pool + routing + quotas (4w), 4) enterprise unredact (6w).
Mina: please include SDK snippet for X-Debug-Mode and a short support blurb explaining surrogates.
Eli: will open RFC and a small prototype PR with perf & cost estimates.
Priya: tagging privacy/legal for review @legal-team.
Oscar: I'll test joins on staging once PR lands.
Eli: thanks, will post RFC link when ready. End of thread.
